rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2-3, Figs 5-13, Table 2 - authors build an ESP32/ThingsBoard IoT irrigation system and report their own sensor readings (temperature, humidity, soil moisture, water level) from a test area in Fez, Morocco, plus e-mail notification tests.
rows.notes: The study demonstrates that the system provides remote monitoring via ThingsBoard dashboards, threshold-based pump control and e-mail alerts to farm owners; it does not measure or report anything about farmer stress, workload or wellbeing. No farmer survey or user evaluation is reported. The remote-monitoring capability is at most a precondition for the claimed stress reduction, so Q2 is no and upstream is set. The 'test' consists of a few minutes of sensor readings (Table 2, 2023-11-28 17:39-17:40) with near-constant values; no crop or water-use outcome is measured either.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references). Study is a system-design/proof-of-concept paper with minimal field data; it reports no outcome on farmers' stress or wellbeing.
